gaps.title: Unified Cold‑Chain Visibility
gaps.detail: While Preferred Freezer operates over 200 temperature‑controlled facilities worldwide, there is no evidence of a centralized IoT platform to monitor temperature, humidity, and compliance in real time across this footprint.
gaps.based_on: The combined entity has over 1.3 billion cubic feet of temperature‑controlled capacity across more than 200 facilities worldwide.

gaps.title: Real‑time Warehouse Inventory
gaps.detail: Only 17 of the combined facilities are described as automated, implying the majority still rely on manual inventory processes that limit operational visibility and efficiency.
gaps.based_on: Post‑merger, the combined company operates 17 automated facilities with more than 800,000 automated pallet positions.

gaps.title: Global Asset & Fleet Tracking
gaps.detail: With a global network spanning the U.S., China, Vietnam and other regions, tracking of high‑value equipment and transport assets likely depends on legacy methods, risking loss or compliance gaps.
gaps.based_on: Preferred Freezer Services designs, constructs, and operates state‑of‑the‑art temperature‑controlled warehouses in the United States and internationally (including China and Vietnam).

pitch.angle: After the Lineage acquisition, Preferred Freezer now runs a massive, multi‑regional cold‑chain operation, but the lack of a unified IoT backbone can hinder real‑time compliance and efficiency. GND’s ThinxFresh platform and IoT‑driven warehouse tools can instantly surface temperature deviations, automate audit reporting, and give you end‑to‑end visibility across every pallet and asset.
pitch.opener: Congrats on scaling to 200+ facilities with Lineage—let's future‑proof your cold‑chain data with a single real‑time dashboard.
